tasks.title: IPv6: publish the LAN's prefix (feature B)
tasks.description: Publish the /64 that the router's LAN clients get addresses from, as a TXT record on a name of its own, so an app can tell whether an IPv6 client is on the site's network, as it already does over IPv4 with the A record. Read from the LAN interface, never from a lookup service. Opt-in per device, with no fallback; edited by ID, never created; validated as global unicast /64; 'none' when there is no prefix. Plan: docs/DDNS-IPV6-PLAN.md.

subtasks.title: Confirm the site has IPv6
subtasks.description: A global address on the WAN, a delegated prefix, the LAN set to prefix delegation, and which bridge the shared devices join. Nothing else is worth building until this is true.

subtasks.title: Settle the open question on multiple prefixes
subtasks.description: Every non-deprecated prefix, space-separated in one TXT value, or only the newest (docs/DDNS-IPV6-PLAN.md, 'Record shape').

subtasks.title: get_lan_prefixes(interface)
subtasks.description: Parse `ip -6 -o addr show dev <if> scope global`; drop deprecated and tentative addresses; validate global unicast /64 (rejecting ULA, link-local and 2001:db8::/32); return CIDRs.

subtasks.title: Generalize the record get/put to a record type
subtasks.description: _ddns_get_a_record() and _ddns_put_a_record() take a type; keep never-create. Check how Cloudflare round-trips TXT content (quoting) before the idempotent comparison.

subtasks.title: Config, --ddns-update and --status
subtasks.description: ddns_lan6_name and ddns_lan6_interface, both required, no fallback. Write 'none' and escalate when there is no prefix. A state key of its own (<name>/TXT). --status shows the interface's prefix beside the published one.

subtasks.title: Tests
subtasks.description: ip output fixtures (one prefix, renumbering with a deprecated prefix, ULA only, no IPv6), validation, never-create (missing TXT errors, no POST), the idempotent no-op, the 'none' sentinel.

subtasks.title: Docs
subtasks.description: README 'DDNS Auto-Refresh' and the invariants in CLAUDE.md.

subtasks.title: Deploy to the router only
subtasks.description: Create the TXT by hand, set the two keys on the router (no other device), run --ddns-update, check --status and the published value. Instance details in DEPLOYMENT.local.md.

tasks.title: IPv6: the router's own AAAA (feature A)
tasks.description: An AAAA record for the UDM's WAN address on the DDNS name, from a v6-pinned lookup run on the UDM. Blocked on the inbound IPv6 firewall: clients prefer IPv6, so publishing before it is open makes the preferred path the broken one. Needs a reachability gate before the first publish and a ddns_ipv6 = true opt-in. Designed in docs/DDNS-CLOUDFLARE-PLAN.md, 'IPv6 / AAAA — deferred'. Independent of task 1.
